verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail advertises APIs for connecting the mailbox to other tools, so scoped API credentials are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes issuing API keys or tokens, permission scopes, or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Multi-user mailbox access and two-factor authentication are adjacent controls and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
